passages.title: The Language of the Hive
passages.text: Honeybees communicate the location of food through a remarkable behaviour known as the waggle dance. When a forager finds a rich patch of flowers, it returns to the hive and moves in a figure-of-eight pattern on the vertical honeycomb. The angle of the straight central run, measured against the direction of gravity, indicates the direction of the food in relation to the sun. The duration of the waggle shows the distance: the longer the waggle, the farther the flowers. Other bees follow the dancer closely, touching her with their antennae, and then fly out to find the source. Scientists once doubted that an insect could pass on such precise information, but decades of careful experiments have confirmed the system. Interestingly, the dance remains accurate even on cloudy days, because bees can detect patterns of polarised light in the sky. This ability, invisible to humans, allows the colony to gather food efficiently, and it reminds us how much remains to be discovered about even the smallest creatures.

passages.title: The Potter's Wheel
passages.text:
The wheel spins slowly in the dusty yard,
And clay, once lifeless, learns to rise;
The potter's hands, though rough and scarred,
Hold patience in their gentle ties.
He does not hurry, does not force,
But coaxes shape from shapeless earth;
Each curve is born of steady course,
Each vessel is a quiet birth.
Some pots will carry water home,
Some hold the lamps of festival;
He never knows where they will roam,
Yet shapes each one as if for all.
The sun goes down; the pots are set
In rows to dry, a silent crowd.
He wipes his brow, and has not yet
Said whether he is tired or proud.
Tomorrow, more clay will wait;
He smiles, for work is not a weight.

passages.title: Libraries Are Not a Luxury
passages.text: Public libraries are often the first casualties when municipal budgets are trimmed. Their value does not appear on a balance sheet: no ribbon is cut for a child who finds her first book, and no statistic records the unemployed young man who prepares for an interview at a reading-room table. Yet these quiet transactions shape a city's future far more than many showy projects do. Critics argue that in the age of smartphones, libraries are redundant. This argument confuses information with understanding. A phone may supply a million facts, but a library offers a calm space, trained guidance and, above all, a community of readers. Closing such institutions to save a small sum is like cutting down an orchard to save the cost of watering it. Councils would do well to remember that a society is judged not only by the roads it builds but also by the minds it nourishes. It is time to treat libraries as essential infrastructure, not as optional luxuries.

questions.question: She ______ in this school since 2010.
questions.explanation: 'Since 2010' shows an action that began in the past and continues now, so the present perfect continuous 'has been teaching' is used. Simple present, present continuous and simple past do not fit 'since'.

questions.question: Identify the clause in italics: "The book that you lent me is excellent."
questions.explanation: "that you lent me" modifies the noun "book" and is essential to identify which book is meant, so it is a defining relative clause. It is not set off by commas (so not non-defining), it does not act as a noun, and it does not tell time.

questions.question: Convert into a compound sentence: "Despite being poor, he was honest."
options: He was poor, so he was honest.
He was poor because he was honest.
Though he was poor, he was honest.
He was poor, but he was honest.
questions.explanation: A compound sentence joins two independent clauses with a coordinator; "but" keeps the contrast. Option C is a complex sentence.

questions.question: Change into indirect speech: He said to me, "Where do you live?"
options: He asked me where do I live.
He asked me where I lived.
He told me where I lived.
He asked me where did I live.
questions.explanation: A wh-question is reported with "asked", normal word order and backshift (live to lived), "you" to "I". The other options keep question order or use "told".

questions.question: Hardly had he reached the office ______ the phone rang.
questions.explanation: "Hardly ... when" is the correct correlative pair; "than" goes with "No sooner". "While" and "after" do not fit this pattern.

questions.question: Unless you ______ now, you will miss the train.
questions.explanation: "Unless" already carries a negative sense, so the verb in the if-clause is in the simple present: "Unless you hurry".

questions.question: Which of the following sentences contains ellipsis (omission of words that can be recovered from the context)?
options: Ravi likes tea and Mohan likes coffee.
Ravi likes tea and Mohan coffee.
Ravi, who likes tea, is here.
questions.explanation: In "Mohan coffee" the verb "likes" is omitted but understood from the first clause, which is ellipsis (gapping). The other sentences are complete; nothing is omitted.

questions.question: He has ______ friends in the city, so he feels lonely.
questions.explanation: "Few" (with a plural countable noun) means almost none and gives a negative sense that fits "lonely". "A few" is positive; "little" and "a little" are used with uncountable nouns.

questions.question: You ______ smoke here; it is strictly prohibited.
questions.explanation: "Mustn't" expresses prohibition. "Needn't" means no necessity, while "may" and "can" would suggest permission, which contradicts "prohibited".

questions.question: Nobody called me yesterday, ______?
questions.explanation: "Nobody" is negative in meaning, so the tag is positive; "nobody" is referred to by "they". Hence "did they".

questions.question: Identify the non-finite verb: "Seeing the tiger, the boy ran away."
questions.explanation: "Seeing" is a present participle and has no tense or subject agreement, so it is non-finite. "Ran" is the finite verb; "boy" and "tiger" are nouns.

questions.question: Each of the players ______ a medal.
questions.explanation: 'Each' takes a singular verb, so 'has won' is correct. 'Have won' and 'win' are plural; 'were winning' does not fit the sense.

questions.question: I ______ in this city since 2015.
questions.explanation: "Since 2015" shows an action that began in the past and continues now, so the present perfect continuous is used. "Am living" and "lived" do not link past to present; "had lived" is past perfect.

questions.question: Identify the noun clause: "I do not know what he wants."
questions.explanation: "What he wants" is the object of "know", so it works as a noun clause. "I do not know" is the main clause; the other options are not clauses in the sentence.

questions.question: In "Some people like tea; others, coffee", which word is omitted from the second clause?
questions.explanation: The clause means "others like coffee"; the verb "like" is left out to avoid repetition, which is ellipsis.

questions.question: Choose the meaning of the idiom "to bite the bullet".
options: To face a painful situation bravely
questions.explanation: The idiom means to endure something unpleasant with courage. The other meanings are not related to the phrase.

questions.question: Identify the figure of speech in "deafening silence".
questions.explanation: Two contradictory words are combined in one phrase, which is an oxymoron.

questions.question: How many morphemes are there in the word "unbreakable"?
questions.explanation: un- + break + -able: one prefix, one root and one suffix, so three morphemes.

questions.question: In which sentence is the word "bank" used in the sense of the edge of a river?
options: I need to deposit money in the bank.
The bank will open at ten.
We sat on the bank and watched the boats.
He works as a clerk in a bank.
questions.explanation: "Bank" is polysemous. Only the first sentence refers to land beside the water; the rest refer to a financial institution.

questions.question: He ______ a lie to his teacher.
questions.explanation: The natural collocation is "tell a lie". "Say a lie", "speak a lie" and "talk a lie" are not idiomatic.

questions.question: The word "light" in "Light the lamp" is used as a ______.
questions.explanation: Here "light" is an action word (to ignite), so it works as a verb. As a noun it would name brightness; as an adjective it would describe a noun.

questions.question: The phrase "on the other hand" is used to ______.
questions.explanation: "On the other hand" is a lexical bundle that signals contrast. Similarity, examples and conclusions use "similarly", "for instance" and "in conclusion".

questions.question: Choose the meaning of "a blessing in disguise".
options: Something good that seems bad at first
questions.explanation: The idiom describes a misfortune that later proves beneficial. The other meanings are literal guesses and are wrong.

questions.question: "Deafening silence" is an example of ______.
questions.explanation: An oxymoron joins two contradictory words (deafening + silence). A metaphor compares directly; a simile uses "like/as"; a euphemism is a softer word for something unpleasant.

questions.question: Which of the following pairs consists of homophones?
questions.explanation: "Knight" and "night" sound the same but differ in spelling and meaning. The other pairs differ in pronunciation.

questions.question: The verb form of the noun "strength" is ______.
questions.explanation: Adding -en to "strength" gives the verb "strengthen". The other forms do not exist.

questions.question: He was arrested for ______ a serious crime.
questions.explanation: We "commit" a crime. "Doing", "making" and "performing" a crime are not natural collocations.

questions.question: What does the idiom "to turn a blind eye" mean?
options: To close the eyes in prayer
To pretend not to notice something wrong
questions.explanation: "Turn a blind eye" means to deliberately ignore something one knows is wrong.

questions.question: "I have told you a million times to be on time." The figure of speech used is ______.
questions.explanation: A "million times" is an obvious overstatement for emphasis, which is hyperbole. It is not irony (opposite meaning), a pun (wordplay) or metonymy (substitution of a related name).

questions.question: Which of the following can be used both as a noun and as a verb without any change in form?
questions.explanation: "Walk" works as a noun ("a walk") and a verb ("to walk"). "Beauty" is only a noun, "quickly" is an adverb and "happy" is an adjective.

questions.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How honeybees share information about food through dance
questions.explanation: The whole passage explains the waggle dance and how it indicates the direction and distance of food. The other topics are not discussed.

questions.question: According to the passage, the distance of the food is shown by ______.
options: the angle of the central run
questions.explanation: The passage says "the duration of the waggle shows the distance". The angle shows direction; antennae touching is how bees follow; polarised light helps on cloudy days.

questions.question: The word "precise" in the passage (precise information) most nearly means ______.
questions.explanation: "Precise" means exact and accurate; the dance conveys exact direction and distance.

questions.question: It can be inferred from the passage that earlier scientists ______.
options: were sure bees could not fly
questions.explanation: The line "Scientists once doubted that an insect could pass on such precise information" implies they underestimated insects. The other statements have no basis.

questions.question: The tone of the writer in the last sentence is ______.
questions.explanation: The writer marvels at bees ("reminds us how much remains to be discovered"), which shows admiration and curiosity.

questions.question: The central idea of the poem is ______.
options: dedication and patience in humble work
questions.explanation: The poem shows the potter working patiently and shaping every pot with care. It does not deal with wealth, old age or festivals as its main idea.

questions.question: In "clay, once lifeless, learns to rise", the poet uses ______.
questions.explanation: Clay is given the human ability to learn, which is personification. No comparison word is used (simile), nothing is exaggerated, and there is no opposite meaning.

questions.question: The lines "has not yet / Said whether he is tired or proud" suggest that the potter feels ______.
questions.explanation: He does not say whether he is tired or proud, which suggests that both feelings are mixed. Anger, boredom and fear are not hinted at.

questions.question: The word "coaxes" in the poem means ______.
questions.explanation: He "does not force" but "coaxes", so it means to persuade gently.

questions.question: What does the last line, "for work is not a weight", mean?
options: He has no work to do
He wants to lift heavy loads
To him work is a joy, not a burden
He is too poor to rest
questions.explanation: The potter smiles at the thought of more work, so he does not see it as a burden. The others misread the line.

questions.question: The writer's main argument is that ______.
options: libraries deserve funding as essential infrastructure
questions.explanation: The last sentence says libraries should be treated "as essential infrastructure". The writer does not attack smartphones or roads.

questions.question: The comparison "like cutting down an orchard to save the cost of watering it" is a ______.
questions.explanation: The comparison uses "like", so it is a simile. A metaphor would not use "like", and there is no irony or personification.

questions.question: The phrase "municipal budgets are trimmed" means that the budgets are ______.
questions.explanation: To trim a budget is to cut it down or reduce it.

questions.question: By saying the argument "confuses information with understanding", the writer implies that ______.
options: having facts is not the same as understanding them
questions.explanation: The writer admits a phone supplies facts but says a library also offers guidance and a community, so facts alone do not mean understanding.

questions.question: The tone of the editorial can best be described as ______.
questions.explanation: The writer argues strongly and urges action ("It is time to ..."), which is an earnest and persuasive tone.

questions.question: In modern English language teaching, grammar is best taught ______.
questions.questionHi: अंग्रेज़ी भाषा शिक्षण में व्याकरण को सबसे अच्छी तरह कैसे पढ़ाया जाना चाहिए?
options: only after students finish the textbook
in context, as a tool for meaningful communication
optionsHi: पाठ्यपुस्तक पूरी होने के बाद ही
संदर्भ में, सार्थक संप्रेषण के साधन के रूप में
questions.explanation: Grammar is a means to communicate. Teaching it in context through use helps learners apply it. Rote rule learning, translation-only and delayed teaching do not build communication.
questions.explanationHi: व्याकरण संप्रेषण का साधन है। संदर्भ में प्रयोग के साथ सिखाने से छात्र उसे लागू कर पाते हैं। नियम रटना, केवल अनुवाद या देर से सिखाना संप्रेषण नहीं बढ़ाता।

questions.question: Which method gives prime importance to grammar rules and translation, using the mother tongue as the medium?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सी विधि व्याकरण के नियमों और अनुवाद को सबसे अधिक महत्व देती है और माध्यम के रूप में मातृभाषा का उपयोग करती है?
questions.explanation: The Grammar-Translation Method teaches rules and translation using the mother tongue. The other methods reduce or avoid the use of the mother tongue.
questions.explanationHi: व्याकरण-अनुवाद विधि में नियम और अनुवाद मातृभाषा के माध्यम से सिखाए जाते हैं। अन्य विधियाँ मातृभाषा का प्रयोग कम या बंद करती हैं।

questions.question: Which method avoids the use of the mother tongue and uses objects, pictures and demonstration to teach meaning?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सी विधि मातृभाषा के प्रयोग से बचती है और अर्थ सिखाने के लिए वस्तुओं, चित्रों तथा प्रदर्शन का उपयोग करती है?
questions.explanation: The Direct Method links words directly to objects and actions without translation. The Grammar-Translation and Bilingual methods use the mother tongue.
questions.explanationHi: प्रत्यक्ष विधि में शब्दों को सीधे वस्तुओं और क्रियाओं से जोड़ा जाता है, अनुवाद नहीं किया जाता। व्याकरण-अनुवाद और द्विभाषिक विधि में मातृभाषा का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Total Physical Response (TPR), which links language with physical action, was developed by ______.
questions.questionHi: भाषा को शारीरिक क्रिया से जोड़ने वाली टोटल फिजिकल रिस्पांस (TPR) पद्धति किसने विकसित की?
questions.explanation: James Asher developed TPR, in which learners respond to commands with physical movement.
questions.explanationHi: जेम्स एशर ने TPR विकसित की, जिसमें शिक्षार्थी आदेशों का उत्तर शारीरिक गति से देते हैं।

questions.question: Coloured Cuisenaire rods are a characteristic teaching aid of which method?
questions.questionHi: रंगीन क्यूज़ेनेयर छड़ें किस शिक्षण पद्धति का विशिष्ट साधन हैं?
questions.explanation: Caleb Gattegno's Silent Way uses coloured rods to teach vocabulary and structures.
questions.explanationHi: केलेब गैटेग्नो की साइलेंट वे में शब्दावली और संरचनाएँ सिखाने के लिए रंगीन छड़ों का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: In Task-Based Language Teaching (TBLT), the main unit of the lesson is a ______.
questions.questionHi: कार्य-आधारित भाषा शिक्षण (TBLT) में पाठ की मुख्य इकाई क्या होती है?
questions.explanation: TBLT organises learning around meaningful tasks such as planning a trip. Rules, word lists and dictation are not its central unit.
questions.explanationHi: TBLT में सीखना सार्थक कार्यों, जैसे यात्रा की योजना बनाना, के आसपास संगठित होता है। नियम, शब्द-सूची और श्रुतलेख इसकी मुख्य इकाई नहीं हैं।

questions.question: A teacher has students with different home languages. The best approach is to ______.
questions.questionHi: एक शिक्षक की कक्षा में छात्रों की घरेलू भाषाएँ अलग-अलग हैं। सबसे अच्छा तरीका क्या है?
options: treat the languages of the learners as a resource for learning
punish the use of home language
teach only the students who know English
optionsHi: अंग्रेज़ी के अलावा सभी भाषाओं पर रोक लगाना
छात्रों की भाषाओं को सीखने के संसाधन के रूप में उपयोग करना
घरेलू भाषा बोलने पर दंड देना
केवल उन्हीं को पढ़ाना जो अंग्रेज़ी जानते हैं
questions.explanation: Multilingualism is a strength; using home languages helps understanding and builds confidence. Banning or punishing them harms learning and excludes learners.
questions.explanationHi: बहुभाषिकता एक शक्ति है; घरेलू भाषाओं के प्रयोग से समझ और आत्मविश्वास बढ़ता है। प्रतिबंध या दंड से सीखना बाधित होता है और बच्चे बाहर हो जाते हैं।

questions.question: A "mistake" differs from an "error" because a mistake is ______.
questions.questionHi: "Mistake" (भूल) और "error" (त्रुटि) में अंतर यह है कि mistake क्या है?
options: a result of lack of knowledge of the rule
a performance slip that the learner can usually self-correct
a sign of a language disorder
optionsHi: नियम के ज्ञान की कमी का परिणाम
व्यवस्थित और बार-बार होने वाला विचलन
प्रदर्शन में हुई चूक, जिसे सीखने वाला प्रायः स्वयं सुधार सकता है
questions.explanation: Mistakes are random slips (tiredness, carelessness) and can be self-corrected. Errors reflect gaps in knowledge and are systematic.
questions.explanationHi: Mistake थकान या लापरवाही से हुई आकस्मिक चूक है जिसे स्वयं सुधारा जा सकता है। Error ज्ञान की कमी दिखाती है और व्यवस्थित होती है।

questions.question: The term "interlanguage" refers to ______.
questions.questionHi: "अंतर्भाषा" (interlanguage) शब्द किसे दर्शाता है?
options: the learner's developing language system between the first language and the target language
a language used between two countries
the mother tongue of the learner
optionsHi: सीखने वाले की पहली भाषा और लक्ष्य भाषा के बीच विकसित हो रही भाषा-प्रणाली
दो देशों के बीच प्रयुक्त भाषा
questions.explanation: Interlanguage (Selinker) is the transitional system a second language learner builds, with features of L1 and L2. The other options are not what the term means.
questions.explanationHi: अंतर्भाषा (सेलिंकर) वह संक्रमणकालीन प्रणाली है जो द्वितीय भाषा सीखने वाला बनाता है, जिसमें L1 और L2 दोनों की विशेषताएँ होती हैं। अन्य विकल्प इस शब्द का अर्थ नहीं हैं।

questions.question: The English textbook should be used by the teacher mainly as ______.
questions.questionHi: अंग्रेज़ी की पाठ्यपुस्तक का शिक्षक को मुख्य रूप से किस प्रकार उपयोग करना चाहिए?
options: one of the resources for learning, along with other materials
a book to be memorised word by word
optionsHi: अन्य सामग्री के साथ सीखने के एक संसाधन के रूप में
questions.explanation: A textbook is a useful resource but should be supplemented by multimedia and local resources. Treating it as the only source or memorising it limits learning.
questions.explanationHi: पाठ्यपुस्तक उपयोगी संसाधन है, पर उसके साथ मल्टीमीडिया और स्थानीय संसाधन भी लेने चाहिए। उसे एकमात्र स्रोत मानना या रटवाना सीखने को सीमित करता है।

questions.question: Remedial teaching in language begins with ______.
questions.questionHi: भाषा में उपचारात्मक शिक्षण की शुरुआत किससे होती है?
optionsHi: सीखने वाले की कठिनाइयों के निदान से
questions.explanation: Remedial work must first identify the exact problem (diagnosis) before planning suitable activities. Extra homework, exams or demotion do not address the cause.
questions.explanationHi: उपचारात्मक कार्य में पहले सही समस्या पहचानी जाती है (निदान), फिर उपयुक्त गतिविधियाँ बनती हैं। अधिक गृहकार्य, परीक्षा या पदावनति कारण को नहीं सुलझाती।

questions.question: In Krashen's Input Hypothesis, "i + 1" means ______.
questions.questionHi: क्रैशेन की इनपुट परिकल्पना में "i + 1" का क्या अर्थ है?
options: input exactly at the current level
input slightly above the learner's current level
the first lesson of a course
optionsHi: सीखने वाले के वर्तमान स्तर से थोड़ा ऊपर का इनपुट
questions.explanation: Here "i" is the current level and "+1" is the next stage, so comprehensible input should be a little beyond the learner's present ability. The other options misread the formula.
questions.explanationHi: यहाँ "i" वर्तमान स्तर है और "+1" अगला चरण, यानी बोधगम्य इनपुट सीखने वाले की वर्तमान क्षमता से थोड़ा आगे होना चाहिए। अन्य विकल्प सूत्र को गलत समझते हैं।

questions.question: According to B. F. Skinner, language is learned through ______.
questions.questionHi: बी. एफ. स्किनर के अनुसार भाषा कैसे सीखी जाती है?
questions.explanation: Skinner, a behaviourist, said language is a habit formed through imitation and reinforcement. LAD is Chomsky's idea, ZPD is Vygotsky's and stages are Piaget's.
questions.explanationHi: व्यवहारवादी स्किनर के अनुसार भाषा अनुकरण और पुनर्बलन से बनी आदत है। LAD चॉम्स्की का, ZPD वाइगोत्स्की का और अवस्थाएँ पियाजे का विचार हैं।

questions.question: The concept of the Language Acquisition Device (LAD) was given by ______.
questions.questionHi: भाषा अर्जन युक्ति (LAD) की अवधारणा किसने दी?
questions.explanation: Chomsky proposed that children are born with an innate LAD. Skinner stressed reinforcement, Vygotsky social interaction and Krashen input.
questions.explanationHi: चॉम्स्की ने कहा कि बच्चे जन्म से ही LAD लेकर आते हैं। स्किनर ने पुनर्बलन, वाइगोत्स्की ने सामाजिक अंतःक्रिया और क्रैशेन ने इनपुट पर बल दिया।

questions.question: The branch of linguistics that studies how words combine to form sentences is ______.
questions.questionHi: भाषाविज्ञान की वह शाखा जो शब्दों के मिलकर वाक्य बनाने का अध्ययन करती है, क्या कहलाती है?
questions.explanation: Syntax deals with sentence structure and word order. Semantics is meaning; phonology and phonetics deal with sounds.
questions.explanationHi: सिंटैक्स वाक्य-संरचना और शब्द-क्रम का अध्ययन है। सिमेंटिक्स अर्थ का, फोनोलॉजी व फोनेटिक्स ध्वनियों का अध्ययन करते हैं।

questions.question: Albert Bandura's social learning theory emphasises learning through ______.
questions.questionHi: अल्बर्ट बैंडुरा का सामाजिक अधिगम सिद्धांत किसके द्वारा सीखने पर बल देता है?
optionsHi: आदर्श (model) के अवलोकन और अनुकरण द्वारा
questions.explanation: Bandura showed (Bobo doll experiment) that people learn by watching others. Trial and error is Thorndike, classical conditioning is Pavlov and insight is Gestalt.
questions.explanationHi: बैंडुरा ने (बोबो डॉल प्रयोग से) दिखाया कि लोग दूसरों को देखकर सीखते हैं। प्रयास-त्रुटि थॉर्नडाइक, शास्त्रीय अनुबंधन पावलोव और अंतर्दृष्टि गेस्टाल्ट से जुड़ी है।

questions.question: In Gardner's theory, sensitivity to rhythm, pitch and melody belongs to ______ intelligence.
questions.questionHi: गार्डनर के सिद्धांत में लय, स्वर-तीव्रता और धुन की संवेदनशीलता किस बुद्धि से संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: Musical intelligence is the capacity to perceive and produce rhythm, pitch and melody.
questions.explanationHi: संगीतात्मक बुद्धि लय, स्वर और धुन को पहचानने व रचने की क्षमता है।

questions.question: Sternberg's triarchic theory of intelligence includes analytical, creative and ______ intelligence.
questions.questionHi: स्टर्नबर्ग के त्रिआयामी बुद्धि सिद्धांत में विश्लेषणात्मक, सृजनात्मक और ______ बुद्धि शामिल है।
questions.explanation: The three parts are analytical, creative and practical. Musical, spatial and naturalist are among the multiple intelligences of Gardner.
questions.explanationHi: तीन भाग विश्लेषणात्मक, सृजनात्मक और व्यावहारिक हैं। संगीतात्मक, स्थानिक और प्रकृतिवादी गार्डनर की बहु-बुद्धियों में आते हैं।

questions.question: The concept of "emotional intelligence" was popularised by ______.
questions.questionHi: "भावात्मक बुद्धि" की अवधारणा को किसने लोकप्रिय बनाया?
questions.explanation: Daniel Goleman popularised emotional intelligence: awareness and management of one's own and others' emotions.
questions.explanationHi: डेनियल गोलमैन ने भावात्मक बुद्धि को लोकप्रिय बनाया: अपनी और दूसरों की भावनाओं को समझना व सँभालना।

questions.question: In Spearman's two-factor theory of intelligence, "g" stands for ______.
questions.questionHi: स्पीयरमैन के द्विकारक बुद्धि सिद्धांत में "g" का अर्थ क्या है?
questions.explanation: Spearman proposed a general factor "g" and specific factors "s". "Group factor" belongs to Thurstone's idea.
questions.explanationHi: स्पीयरमैन ने सामान्य कारक "g" और विशिष्ट कारक "s" बताए। समूह कारक थर्स्टन के विचार से संबंधित है।

questions.question: In Pavlov's experiment, the sound of the bell that came to produce salivation was the ______.
questions.questionHi: पावलोव के प्रयोग में घंटी की आवाज़, जो लार-स्राव कराने लगी, क्या थी?
questions.explanation: The bell was originally neutral; after pairing with food it became a conditioned stimulus.
questions.explanationHi: घंटी पहले तटस्थ थी; भोजन के साथ जोड़ने पर वह अनुकूलित उद्दीपक बन गई।

questions.question: Comparing a student's score with the performance of other students in the group is called ______-referenced interpretation.
questions.questionHi: किसी विद्यार्थी के अंकों की तुलना समूह के अन्य विद्यार्थियों के प्रदर्शन से करना ______-संदर्भित व्याख्या कहलाती है।
questions.explanation: Norm-referenced interpretation ranks a learner relative to a peer group; criterion-referenced compares with a fixed standard.
questions.explanationHi: नॉर्म-संदर्भित व्याख्या विद्यार्थी को समकक्ष समूह के सापेक्ष आँकती है; क्राइटेरियन-संदर्भित व्याख्या निश्चित मानक से तुलना करती है।

questions.question: A test that compares a student's score with the performance of other students is ______.
questions.questionHi: वह परीक्षण जो किसी छात्र के अंकों की तुलना अन्य छात्रों के प्रदर्शन से करता है, क्या कहलाता है?
questions.explanation: Norm-referenced tests rank students against a group. Criterion-referenced tests compare with a fixed standard; diagnostic tests locate difficulties.
questions.explanationHi: मानक-संदर्भित परीक्षण छात्रों को समूह के सापेक्ष रैंक देते हैं। मानदंड-संदर्भित परीक्षण निश्चित स्तर से तुलना करते हैं; निदानात्मक परीक्षण कठिनाइयाँ खोजते हैं।

questions.question: A test whose scores are free from the personal bias of the examiner is said to have ______.
questions.questionHi: जिस परीक्षण के अंक परीक्षक के व्यक्तिगत पक्षपात से मुक्त हों, उसमें ______ होती है।
questions.explanation: Objectivity means different scorers give the same score to the same answer.
questions.explanationHi: वस्तुनिष्ठता का अर्थ है कि अलग-अलग जाँचकर्ता एक ही उत्तर को समान अंक दें।

questions.question: A purposeful collection of a learner's work over time, showing progress, is called a ______.
questions.questionHi: समय के साथ विद्यार्थी के कार्य का उद्देश्यपूर्ण संग्रह, जो उसकी प्रगति दिखाए, क्या कहलाता है?
questions.explanation: A portfolio gathers samples of work to show growth and effort over a period.
questions.explanationHi: पोर्टफोलियो में कार्य के नमूने एकत्र होते हैं जो किसी अवधि में विकास और प्रयास दर्शाते हैं।

questions.question: A key recommendation of NCF 2005 is to ______.
questions.questionHi: NCF 2005 की एक मुख्य सिफारिश क्या है?
options: connect knowledge to life outside the school and reduce rote learning
optionsHi: ज्ञान को स्कूल के बाहर के जीवन से जोड़ना और रटने को कम करना
स्कूल को समुदाय से अलग करना
questions.explanation: NCF 2005 stresses learning without burden and linking learning with real life. The other options are opposite to its vision.
questions.explanationHi: NCF 2005 बोझ-रहित अधिगम और सीखने को वास्तविक जीवन से जोड़ने पर बल देता है। अन्य विकल्प इसकी दृष्टि के विपरीत हैं।

questions.question: The method in which learners carry out a real-life task over a period, learning by doing, is the ______ method.
questions.questionHi: जिस विधि में शिक्षार्थी किसी वास्तविक जीवन के कार्य को कुछ समय तक करके, करके सीखते हैं, वह ______ विधि है।
questions.explanation: The project method centres on learning by doing through a purposeful, real-life activity.
questions.explanationHi: प्रोजेक्ट विधि उद्देश्यपूर्ण, वास्तविक जीवन की गतिविधि द्वारा करके सीखने पर केंद्रित है।

questions.question: The school structure proposed in NCF-SE 2023 is ______.
questions.questionHi: NCF-SE 2023 में प्रस्तावित स्कूली संरचना कौन-सी है?
questions.explanation: NCF-SE 2023 follows the 5+3+3+4 structure (foundational, preparatory, middle, secondary). 10+2 is the older structure.
questions.explanationHi: NCF-SE 2023 में 5+3+3+4 संरचना (आधारभूत, तैयारी, मध्य, माध्यमिक) है। 10+2 पुरानी संरचना है।

questions.question: Reflective practice by a teacher means ______.
questions.questionHi: शिक्षक के लिए चिंतनशील अभ्यास (रिफ्लेक्टिव प्रैक्टिस) का अर्थ है-
options: critically thinking about one's own teaching in order to improve it
copying the methods of senior teachers
repeating the same lesson every year
optionsHi: अपने शिक्षण पर आलोचनात्मक चिंतन कर उसे सुधारना
वरिष्ठ शिक्षकों की विधियों की नकल करना
questions.explanation: Reflective practice is systematic self-analysis of one's teaching to improve it.
questions.explanationHi: चिंतनशील अभ्यास अपने शिक्षण का व्यवस्थित आत्म-विश्लेषण है, ताकि उसमें सुधार हो।

questions.question: A gender-sensitive classroom practice is to ______.
questions.questionHi: लैंगिक रूप से संवेदनशील कक्षा-व्यवहार क्या है?
options: give equal opportunities to boys and girls and avoid stereotypes
optionsHi: सफाई का काम केवल लड़कियों को देना
लड़कों और लड़कियों को समान अवसर देना तथा रूढ़ियों से बचना
questions.explanation: Equal opportunity and removal of stereotypes make a classroom gender-sensitive. The other practices reinforce bias.
questions.explanationHi: समान अवसर और रूढ़ियों का निवारण कक्षा को लैंगिक रूप से संवेदनशील बनाता है। अन्य व्यवहार पक्षपात को बढ़ाते हैं।

questions.question: "आशीर्वाद" शब्द की सही वर्तनी किस विकल्प में दी गई है?
questions.explanation: शुद्ध रूप "आशीर्वाद" है (आशीः + वाद)। शेष वर्तनियाँ अशुद्ध हैं।

questions.question: "अनुशासन" शब्द में उपसर्ग कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: "अनुशासन" = अनु + शासन। यहाँ "अनु" उपसर्ग है और "शासन" मूल शब्द है। "अन" और "न" उपसर्ग नहीं हैं।

questions.question: "अग्नि" शब्द का तद्भव रूप कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: "अग्नि" का तद्भव रूप "आग" है। अंगार, ज्वाला और दीप भिन्न अर्थ या शब्द हैं, तद्भव रूप नहीं।

questions.question: इनमें से कौन-सा शब्द "सूर्य" का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.explanation: "शशि" का अर्थ चंद्रमा है। दिनकर, भास्कर और रवि सूर्य के पर्यायवाची हैं।

questions.question: "प्रशंसा" का विलोम शब्द है-
questions.explanation: "प्रशंसा" का विलोम "निंदा" है। अन्य शब्द विलोम नहीं हैं।

questions.question: Choose the one word for "a person who loves mankind and helps others".
questions.explanation: A philanthropist loves mankind and works for human welfare; a misanthrope hates people.

questions.question: A person who can speak many languages is called a ______.
questions.explanation: A polyglot knows several languages. A philatelist collects stamps, a polygamist has more than one spouse and a pedant is overly concerned with rules.

questions.question: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling has double "c" and double "m": accommodation.

questions.question: Complete the proverb: "Make hay while the ______ shines."
questions.explanation: The proverb advises using an opportunity while it lasts. Hay is made when the sun shines.

questions.question: Change into the passive voice: "The teacher praised the student."
options: The student was praised by the teacher.
The student is praised by the teacher.
The student has been praised by the teacher.
The teacher was praised by the student.
questions.explanation: Simple past active becomes "was/were + past participle" in the passive. The other options change the tense or swap the doer and receiver.

questions.question: If 5 March 2024 was a Tuesday, what day of the week was 5 April 2024?
questions.questionHi: यदि 5 मार्च 2024 को मंगलवार था, तो 5 अप्रैल 2024 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: March has 31 days; 31 = 4 weeks + 3 days, so Tuesday + 3 = Friday.
questions.explanationHi: मार्च में 31 दिन होते हैं; 31 = 4 सप्ताह + 3 दिन, इसलिए मंगलवार + 3 = शुक्रवार।

questions.question: In a row of 40 students, Ravi's rank from the left is 15. What is his rank from the right?
questions.questionHi: 40 विद्यार्थियों की एक पंक्ति में रवि का बाईं ओर से स्थान 15वाँ है। दाईं ओर से उसका स्थान कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Rank from right = total - rank from left + 1 = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26.
questions.explanationHi: दाईं ओर से स्थान = कुल - बाईं ओर से स्थान + 1 = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26।

questions.question: A pencil costs Rs 5 and a notebook costs Rs 20. How many pencils can be bought for the price of 6 notebooks?
questions.questionHi: एक पेंसिल की कीमत 5 रुपये और एक कॉपी की कीमत 20 रुपये है। 6 कॉपियों की कीमत में कितनी पेंसिलें आएँगी?
questions.explanation: 6 notebooks cost 6 x 20 = Rs 120. Pencils = 120 / 5 = 24.

questions.question:
Statements: Some cats are dogs. All dogs are birds.
Conclusions: I. Some cats are birds. II. All birds are dogs.
questions.questionHi:
कथन: कुछ बिल्लियाँ कुत्ते हैं। सभी कुत्ते पक्षी हैं।
निष्कर्ष: I. कुछ बिल्लियाँ पक्षी हैं। II. सभी पक्षी कुत्ते हैं।
optionsHi: केवल निष्कर्ष I अनुसरण करता है
केवल निष्कर्ष II अनुसरण करता है
I और II दोनों अनुसरण करते हैं
न I और न II अनुसरण करता है
questions.explanation: The cats that are dogs are also birds, so I follows. II is a wrong conversion of "All dogs are birds".
questions.explanationHi: जो बिल्लियाँ कुत्ते हैं वे पक्षी भी हैं, इसलिए I सही है। II "सभी कुत्ते पक्षी हैं" का गलत विपरीतीकरण है।

questions.question: If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be after 100 days?
questions.questionHi: यदि आज बुधवार है, तो 100 दिन बाद सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन होगा?
questions.explanation: 100 = 14 weeks + 2 days. Two days after Wednesday is Friday.
questions.explanationHi: 100 = 14 सप्ताह + 2 दिन। बुधवार के दो दिन बाद शुक्रवार आता है।

questions.question: In MS Excel, the intersection of a row and a column is called a ______.
questions.questionHi: MS Excel में पंक्ति और स्तंभ के कटान बिंदु को क्या कहते हैं?
questions.explanation: A cell is where a row and a column meet (for example B3). A range is a group of cells, a sheet is a page and a workbook is a whole file.
questions.explanationHi: सेल वह स्थान है जहाँ पंक्ति और स्तंभ मिलते हैं (जैसे B3)। रेंज कई सेलों का समूह, शीट एक पृष्ठ और वर्कबुक पूरी फ़ाइल है।

questions.question: The default file extension of a workbook saved in MS Excel 2007 and later is ______.
questions.questionHi: MS Excel 2007 और बाद के संस्करणों में सहेजी गई वर्कबुक का डिफ़ॉल्ट फ़ाइल एक्सटेंशन क्या है?
questions.explanation: .xlsx is the Excel workbook format; .docx is Word and .pptx is PowerPoint.
questions.explanationHi: .xlsx एक्सेल वर्कबुक का प्रारूप है; .docx वर्ड का और .pptx पावरपॉइंट का है।

questions.question: Which of the following is an antivirus software?
questions.questionHi: निम्न में से कौन-सा एंटीवायरस सॉफ्टवेयर है?
questions.explanation: Quick Heal protects a computer from viruses. Notepad is a text editor, Paint is a drawing tool and Windows Media Player plays media.
questions.explanationHi: क्विक हील कंप्यूटर को वायरस से बचाता है। नोटपैड टेक्स्ट एडिटर, पेंट चित्रण का टूल और विंडोज मीडिया प्लेयर मीडिया चलाने का सॉफ्टवेयर है।

questions.question: 1 Gigabyte (GB) is equal to ______.
questions.questionHi: 1 गीगाबाइट (GB) बराबर होता है-
questions.explanation: In computer storage, 1 GB = 1024 MB, and 1 MB = 1024 KB. The other values are incorrect.
questions.explanationHi: कंप्यूटर संग्रहण में 1 GB = 1024 MB और 1 MB = 1024 KB होता है। अन्य मान गलत हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is a search engine?
questions.questionHi: निम्न में से कौन-सा एक सर्च इंजन है?
questions.explanation: Google searches information on the web. Ubuntu and Windows are operating systems and Photoshop is an image-editing program.
questions.explanationHi: गूगल वेब पर जानकारी खोजता है। उबंटू और विंडोज ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम हैं तथा फ़ोटोशॉप इमेज-एडिटिंग प्रोग्राम है।

questions.question: What is the pH value of pure water at 25 degrees Celsius?
questions.questionHi: 25 डिग्री सेल्सियस पर शुद्ध जल का pH मान कितना होता है?
questions.explanation: Pure water is neutral and has pH 7 at 25 degrees Celsius. Below 7 is acidic and above 7 is basic.
questions.explanationHi: 25 डिग्री सेल्सियस पर शुद्ध जल उदासीन होता है और उसका pH 7 होता है। 7 से कम अम्लीय और 7 से अधिक क्षारीय होता है।

questions.question: Which bird is the state bird of Chhattisgarh?
questions.questionHi: छत्तीसगढ़ का राजकीय पक्षी कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Hill Myna (Bastar Pahari Myna) is the state bird of Chhattisgarh.
questions.explanationHi: पहाड़ी (बस्तर) मैना छत्तीसगढ़ का राजकीय पक्षी है।

questions.question: The Right to Information Act was enacted in the year ______.
questions.questionHi: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम किस वर्ष पारित किया गया?
questions.explanation: The RTI Act was passed by Parliament in 2005 and came into full force in October 2005. The other years are incorrect.
questions.explanationHi: सूचना का अधिकार अधिनियम संसद द्वारा 2005 में पारित हुआ और अक्टूबर 2005 में पूरी तरह लागू हुआ। अन्य वर्ष गलत हैं।

questions.question: Who was the Viceroy of India at the time of the Partition of Bengal in 1905?
questions.questionHi: 1905 में बंगाल विभाजन के समय भारत का वायसराय कौन था?
questions.explanation: Lord Curzon was Viceroy from 1899 to 1905 and carried out the partition. Ripon, Dalhousie and Mountbatten served in other periods.
questions.explanationHi: लॉर्ड कर्ज़न 1899 से 1905 तक वायसराय थे और उन्होंने विभाजन किया। रिपन, डलहौजी और माउंटबेटन अन्य कालों में थे।

questions.question: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
questions.questionHi: भारत के किस राज्य की तटरेखा सबसे लंबी है?
questions.explanation: Gujarat has the longest coastline among Indian states (over 1,600 km).
questions.explanationHi: भारतीय राज्यों में गुजरात की तटरेखा सबसे लंबी (1,600 किमी से अधिक) है।
